name: Auth0
summary: Auth0 adds MFA to customer-facing apps and is priced by monthly active users, from a free plan to $35 a month for 500 users. Adaptive MFA needs an Enterprise plan with a paid add-on.

evidence.capability: second-factor methods such as app push or hardware keys

facts.text: Auth0 supports push notifications through its Guardian app and WebAuthn security keys such as YubiKey and Google Titan, and says available factors depend on the subscription plan.
Adaptive MFA checks each login and asks for extra verification only when it looks risky, and it requires an Enterprise plan with the Adaptive MFA add-on.
Enrollment is controlled through post-login Actions, where the enrollWith and enrollWithAny commands choose which factors users are prompted to enroll in.
A single user flow can run only four of the enroll and challenge commands.

plans.name: B2C Essentials
plans.notes: $70 at 1,000 users. Yearly billing is 11 times the monthly price

plans.name: B2C Professional
plans.notes: $240 at 1,000 users. Yearly billing is 11 times the monthly price

hiddenCosts: Adaptive MFA needs an Enterprise plan plus its add-on, and neither has a published price.
